*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] withdraws its staff from a hospital in [[central Darfur]], [[Sudan]], after a [[stretcher bearer]] is shot dead and several others are injured, stating that it will not resume operations unless the [[Rapid Support Forces]] guarantee the safety of its personnel and patients. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Insurance in Australia]]
**The [[Australia]]n [[Federal Court of Australia|Federal Court]] fines United Super, the [[Cbus (superannuation fund)|Cbus]] [[pension fund]]'s [[trustee]], [[Australian dollar|A$]]23.5 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]15.2 million) for systemic failures that caused extensive delays in processing [[Life insurance|death]] and [[disability insurance]] claims affecting over 7,000 members. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australian-pension-fund-cbus-fined-over-15-million-death-disability-claim-delays-2025-11-25/ (Reuters)]

[https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/plane-carrying-food-aid-crashes-south-sudan-three-dead-2025-11-25/ (Reuters)]

*[[Food security in Nigeria]], [[Islamic extremism in Northern Nigeria]]
**The [[World Food Programme]] reports that escalating instability in [[Northern Region, Nigeria|northern]] [[Nigeria]] is increasing acute [[Food security|food insecurity]] to record levels, with nearly 35 million people projected to face hunger in 2026 as the agency exhausts its funding by December. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-faces-record-hunger-amid-insurgent-attacks-aid-cuts-2025-11-25/ (Reuters)]

**Former [[Brazil]]ian [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] starts his 27-year sentence for leading [[2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot|a coup plot]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-bolsonaro-prison-sentence-4ffc790826dd9dcd008dc666b6b9dda7 (AP)]
*[[Counter-terrorism in Singapore]]
**[[Singapore]] orders [[Meta Platforms|Meta]] and [[TikTok]] to block local access to the [[social media]] accounts of an [[Australians in Singapore|Australian]] man whose posts advocate replacing [[Religion in Singapore|Singapore's secular system]] with an [[Islamic state]] and seek to [[Islamic extremism|cause communal tensions]] and [[Election interference|influence]] [[Elections in Singapore|elections]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/singapore-blocks-tiktok-meta-accounts-australian-linked-radicalisation-2025-11-26/ (Reuters)]

**A court in [[Amsterdam]], [[Netherlands]], begins the trial of an [[Immigration to Europe|illegal migrant]] from [[Nigeria]] who murdered a 17-year-old girl in [[Duivendrecht]]. *[[LGBTQ rights in the European Union]], [[Same-sex union legislation]]
**The [[European Court of Justice]] rules for all [[European Union]] member states to [[Recognition of same-sex unions in Europe|recognize]] [[same-sex marriage]] and not discriminate against [[homosexuality|same-sex]] couples. The ruling does not force individual countries to legalize same-sex marriages. [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-same-sex-marriage-lgbtq-poland/a-74876738 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Ugandan general election]]
**[[Uganda]]n opposition party [[National Unity Platform]] says [[Uganda People's Defence Force|security forces]] have [[Mass arrest|detained]] more than 300 supporters and officials since [[President of Uganda|presidential]] candidate [[Bobi Wine]] began campaigning, while [[Uganda Police Force|police]] report several arrests linked to clashes at Wine's rallies. '''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**The [[Shenzhou 22]] spacecraft enters [[geocentric orbit|orbit]] after [[China National Space Administration|China]] conducts its first emergency space launch to restore a safe return option for the three astronauts aboard the [[Tiangong space station]] following damage to the [[Shenzhou 20]] return capsule earlier in November. The uncrewed spacecraft, launched on a [[Long March 2F]] rocket, carries replacement parts and supplies and aims to return the current crew to [[Earth]] in 2026. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/china-launch-shenzhou-22-spaceship-0411-gmt-state-media-reports-2025-11-25/ (Reuters)]
